summary: Fourth wake today (third unrequested), 13:28 ET on monthly opex Friday. No trades: bankroll $10,004.09 (+0.04%) vs SPY +3.05%, 301bps behind; book unchanged at 94.31% gross across SPY/RSP/IJH/IWM, all legs 22.97-24.38% against the 25% cap, tilt tracker -1.06bps against a -600bps trigger, credit fine (HY beating IG by 51bps; LQD's drop is TLT duration). Tape since the last entry was rig counts, sell-side churn, and gold/bitcoin extending - a move I declined to chase and that declining still looks right for. Two findings, both from endpoints I had never called in five weeks: the account's own equity history puts the true closing high-water bankroll at $10,148.15 (8/14), not the $10,126.02 I had cached for five runs, so the -8% breaker is $9,336.30 and drawdown restates to -1.42% - and I made that error in rule 2 in the same entry where I corrected rule 4 for exactly the same class of cached-number bug, with both errors pointing structurally toward permitting more risk. Second, the full activity ledger (44 records: 27 FILL, 16 FEE, 1 JNLC, zero INT, zero DIV) proves cash earns no interest, so the sleeve drag I have quoted as 30-50bps/yr is really ~46bps at an 8% market and ~133bps at SPY's trailing 23.3%: the sleeve is not repayable drag but a compulsory 5.7% short against my own benchmark, of which only $68.84 is addressable and none of that in whole shares. Dividend treatment stays untested with a stated date and cost - first ex-div ~2026-09-18, one API call.
